title: Unvalidated ts/timeout_s types stored from POST body
description:
File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/emergency.py:152

Rollcall POST stores ts and timeout_s without type validation; downstream code expects numeric.

**Failure scenario:** POST {"id": "x", "ts": "not-a-number"} stores string; any code doing arithmetic on started/timeout_s raises TypeError.

**Verdict:** CONFIRMED
